records.title: Archaeological explorations at poompuhar
details: a to b: The Central Government has issued permission for exploration at Poompuhar to Tamil Nadu State Department of Archaeology, Government of Tamil Nadu in 2025, and the report on the work conducted by State Department is not submitted as yet.

records.title: Mekedatu Dam Project
details: a to e: In the 28th meeting of CWMA held on 1.02.2024, after detailed deliberation taking into account the views of the majority of the Members of the CWMA, the Authority decided to refer back the Project to CWC for examination of various technical/economical aspects of the project to establish its feasibility.

records.title: Recommendation of Madras High Court
details: a to e: As on 17.03.2025, against the sanctioned strength of 75 in Madras High court, 65 Judges are working. 03 proposals for appointment as Judges of the Madras High Court are under process.
